collection.title: Mercedes-Benz SLK Class 2004 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz SLK Class Roadster 2004 to 2011 (R171) requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
